title: Storage, Processing & Route Maps
selected_by_owner: Owner continued the approved 15-cycle MMHT map tester program following MMHT-11.

in_scope: Author measured storage, stockpiles, warehouses, processing footprints, loading bays, distribution depots and transfer stations with stable map feature IDs and optional facility/profile references.

Join existing farm, mine and workshop anchors to logistics places using explicit directed material and access routes. Author route waypoints, width/height clearance, multi-level hoist connections and hidden branches.

Provide distinct editable Brinegate, Lantern Post and Reedbank Farm examples. Download full draft and GM/player-filtered map references, including unresolved endpoint diagnostics for deleted features.
boundaries: Cartography only: no material production, extraction, processing recipes, throughput, inventory movement, capacity scheduling, transactions or resource simulation.
Graph tracing and clearance checks compare authored spatial data only; live movement/authorization rules remain with owner domains.
Standalone HTML and browser file round-trip do not establish physical Android acceptance or installed-app integration.

evidence.validation: Chromium Playwright loaded standalone HTML via set_content (direct file:// navigation restricted in harness); three samples passed documentError, no page errors. Brinegate: 11 GM / 10 player logistics nodes and 10 GM / 9 player routes. Player export omitted restricted assay annex, gas pocket and concealed vein IDs, geometry, notes and dependent links. Working-face to freight dock uses six explicitly directed links; reverse trace disconnected. Requesting 6 x 7 ft clearance flags narrower conveyor, not a transport simulation. UI saved source-version/clearance metadata while preserving facility ID; created and deleted a route; adopted an existing mine feature without changing its mine identity; drew a four-corner rectangle with mouse; exported actual browser draft and reimported an earlier state as distinct mapped document. Separate roundtrip regression edited revision B then imported saved revision A and recovered label; deleted route endpoint produced explicit unresolved-link diagnostics and filtered player links. All three clean samples exported full editable drafts and player/GM JSON. UI player export matched safe calculated projection and older map tools remained accessible. Browser local autosave unavailable on about:blank; independent file export/import was tested. No physical device, cross-client live integration or owner acceptance.
design_sources: User-supplied Multiversal Map Maker handoff for Downtime and world systems

next_action: Owner reviews Brinegate, Lantern Post and Reedbank logistics maps. Start MMHT-13 Habitat & Land-Use Change Maps on next owner direction.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone HTML review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-12 HTML and 3 clean editable map samples with browser roundtrip, role-filtering and route trace evidence.

stop_reason.evidence: Editable storage/processing areas, directional route authoring, role-filtered exports and browser file roundtrip validated.
